## Declared needs

::: {.need #REQ-APPROVED type="functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="high" tags="security;authentication" verified-by="TC-LOGIN"}
## Authenticate administrators

The service shall authenticate administrators before granting access.
:::

::: {.need #REQ-DRAFT type="functional-requirement" status="draft" priority="low" tags="authentication"}
## Recover credentials

The service shall let an administrator recover a lost credential.
:::

::: {.need #REQ-UNPRIORITIZED type="functional-requirement" status="draft" tags="authentication"}
## Notify administrators

The service shall notify administrators about credential changes.
:::
